Northstar Components
EDI Specifications User Guide
850 - Purchase Order
ANSI X.12 - Release 004010
All content fictional. Synthetic fixture in the terse guide layout.
Data Segment Sequence for Heading Area
Seg. Name Usage Max. Loop
ID Use Repeat
ST Transaction Set Header M 1
BEG Beginning Segment for Purchase Order M 1
CUR Currency O 1
REF Reference Identification M >1
N1 Name M 1 N1 / 3
N3 Address Information O 1 N1 / 3
Data Segment Sequence for Detail Area
Seg. Name Usage Max. Loop
ID Use Repeat
PO1 Baseline Item Data M 1 PO1/100000
Data Segment Sequence for Summary Area
Seg. Name Usage Max. Loop
ID Use Repeat
CTT Transaction Totals M 1
SE Transaction Set Trailer M 1
GLOSSARY
Abbreviations in the columns headed "Usage" have the following definitions:
C Conditional The presence of this item is dependent on other items.
M Mandatory This data segment shall be included in the transaction set.
O Optional The presence of this data segment is at the option of the sender.
N Not used
- 1 -Northstar Components
Segment BEG - Beginning Segment for Purchase Order
Level Heading
Max. Use 1
Purpose To indicate the beginning of the Purchase Order Transaction Set
Comments The segment will indicate the type of purchase order and the P.O. number.
Example BEG*00*NE*NS-2026-0450**20260630
ID ELEMENT NAME FEATURES COMMENTS
BEG01 Transaction Set Purpose Code M ID 2/2 "00" = Original
BEG02 Purchase Order Type Code M ID 2/2 "NE" = New Order
BEG03 Purchase Order Number M AN 1/22 Buyer's purchase order number
BEG04 Release Number N Not Used
BEG05 Purchase Order Date M DT 8/8 Date expressed as CCYYMMDD
- 2 -Northstar Components
Segment REF - Reference Identification
Level Heading
Max. Use >1
Purpose To specify identifying information
Comments The Northstar vendor id is required in the heading of every order.
Example REF*IA*NS-88213
ID ELEMENT NAME FEATURES COMMENTS
REF01 Reference Identification Qualifier M ID 2/3 "IA" = Internal Vendor Number
REF02 Reference Identification M AN 1/30 Reference information
- 3 -Northstar Components
Segment N1 - Name
Level Heading
Max. Use 3
Purpose To identify a party by type of organization, name, and code
Comments This segment identifies the buyer and ship-to party.
Examples N1*BY*BUYER NAME*92*CC
N1*ST*SHIP DEST*92*002000
ID ELEMENT NAME FEATURES COMMENTS
N101 Entity Identifier Code M ID 2/3 Code identifying an organizational entity:
"BY" = Buying Party ( Purchaser )
"ST" = Ship To
N102 Name M AN 1/60 Free-form name
N103 Identification Code Qualifier C ID 1/2 "92" = Assigned by Buyer
N104 Identification Code C AN 2/80 Party code
- 4 -Northstar Components
Segment N3 - Address Information
Level Heading
Max. Use 1
Purpose To specify the location of the named party
ID ELEMENT NAME FEATURES COMMENTS
N301 Address Information M AN 1/55 Address line
N302 Address Information O AN 1/55 Address line
- 5 -Northstar Components
Segment PO1 - Baseline Item Data
Level Detail
Max. Use 100000
Purpose To specify basic line item data
Comments Every line must carry the buyer part number in the BP qualifier.
Example PO1*1*24*EA*18750*CP*BP*NS-1
ID ELEMENT NAME FEATURES COMMENTS
PO101 Assigned Identification O AN 1/20 Line number
PO102 Quantity Ordered M R 1/15 Quantity ordered
PO103 Unit of Measure Code M ID 2/2 "EA" - Each "CS" - Case "PL" - Pallet
PO104 Unit Price M R 1/17 Price with implied decimal
PO106 Product ID Qualifier M ID 2/2 "BP" = Buyer's Part Number
PO107 Product ID M AN 1/48 Buyer's part number
- 6 -Northstar Components
Segment CTT - Transaction Totals
Level Summary
Max. Use 1
Purpose To transmit a hash total for a specific element
ID ELEMENT NAME FEATURES COMMENTS
CTT01 Number of Line Items M N0 1/6 Total number of line items
